race.comment: FUNDAMENTAL NATURE (11) profiles well third up from the right gate with Llewellyn's 3kg claim. Strong through the line in the testing soft (7) conditions when third over 1300m at Sandown-Hillside in easier company. Drops further in weight and set to bounce back. UNLEESHING (7) indicated she was back better than ever with a surprise first-up second to Decorum over 1200m here. Will keep improving as she gets out in trip and is among the leading chances. ALABAMA STATE (15) steps out to his right trip and finally gets a bit of cover today. Value player. CASTLEJOHN (4) is hard to knock after winning both starts so far this time in while NIGHT AGENT (17) is open to improvement second up.
